title: Fed announces first large-scale asset purchases
detail: Program to buy the debt of the housing agencies and agency mortgage-backed securities.

title: Fed cuts its target to 0–0.25%
detail: The FOMC establishes a target range for the federal funds rate of 0 to 1/4 percent.

title: Fed adds Treasuries to its purchases
detail: The FOMC decides to purchase up to $300 billion of longer-term Treasury securities and expands agency purchases.

title: Fed announces a second round of purchases
detail: The FOMC intends to purchase a further $600 billion of longer-term Treasury securities by mid-2011.

title: Fed lengthens the maturity of its holdings
detail: The FOMC intends to buy $400 billion of longer-dated Treasuries and sell the same amount of short-dated ones.

title: Fed begins open-ended purchases
detail: The FOMC begins purchasing agency mortgage-backed securities at $40 billion per month.

title: Fed begins reducing its purchases
detail: The FOMC decides to modestly reduce the pace of its asset purchases beginning in January.

title: Fed ends its asset purchases
detail: The FOMC decides to conclude its asset purchase program.

title: Fed raises its target from the lower bound
detail: The FOMC raises the target range for the federal funds rate to 1/4 to 1/2 percent.

title: Fed announces balance sheet runoff
detail: The FOMC will initiate its balance sheet normalization program in October.

title: Fed ends balance sheet runoff
detail: The FOMC will conclude the reduction of its securities holdings in August, and lowers its target range.

title: Fed begins buying Treasury bills
detail: The Federal Reserve will purchase Treasury bills at least into the second quarter of 2020 to maintain reserves.

title: Fed cuts its target to 0–0.25%
detail: The FOMC lowers the target range for the federal funds rate to 0 to 1/4 percent.

title: Fed makes its purchases open-ended
detail: The Federal Reserve will purchase Treasury and agency mortgage-backed securities in the amounts needed to support market functioning.

title: Fed begins reducing its purchases
detail: The FOMC decides to begin reducing the monthly pace of its net asset purchases.

title: Fed raises its target from the lower bound
detail: The FOMC raises the target range for the federal funds rate to 1/4 to 1/2 percent.

title: Fed announces balance sheet runoff
detail: The FOMC decides to begin reducing its holdings of Treasury and agency securities on June 1.

title: Fed opens emergency funding for banks
detail: The Federal Reserve Board announces it will make additional funding available to eligible depository institutions.

title: Fed slows balance sheet runoff
detail: Beginning in June, the FOMC will slow the pace of decline of its securities holdings.

title: Fed begins cutting its target
detail: The FOMC lowers the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/2 percentage point to 4-3/4 to 5 percent.

title: Fed slows balance sheet runoff again
detail: Beginning in April, the FOMC will further slow the pace of decline of its securities holdings.

title: Fed ends balance sheet runoff
detail: The FOMC decides to conclude the reduction of its securities holdings on December 1.

title: Fed resumes purchases to maintain reserves
detail: The FOMC will initiate purchases of shorter-term Treasury securities as needed to maintain an ample supply of reserves, and lowers its target range to 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent.
